name: Kai Zhong Kenneth Lee
biography: is a security engineer at Etsy. At work, he fiddles around with security features, works on 411 and responds to the occasional bug bounty report. He went to NYU-Poly and got a degree in Computer Science, with a MS in Computer Security. In his free time, he enjoys reverse engineering, CTFs board games, starting yet another project that he’ll never finish and learning all the things. Twitter: @sixhundredns Kenneth Lee is a senior product security engineer at Etsy.com, working on everything from managing the bug bounty program to shattering the site with new vulnerabilities. Previously, Kenneth worked at FactSet Research Systems preventing The Hackers from stealing financial data. He went to Columbia and got an MS in computer science focusing on computer security. Between sweet hacks, Kenneth enjoys drinking tea and force feeding Etsy's operations team with Japanese chocolates. Twitter: @kennysan
